title: Energetic versus count-based heart-rate reversals: cross-dataset age-group prediction with a major calibration failure
abstract: Reversal-associated RR-increment energy reduced external age-group Brier loss by 0.05509 versus a fixed time-domain HRV plus count-fragmentation baseline (joint bootstrap95% improvement0.00324–0.13358), but the transferred model remained worse than a constant predictor and does not establish clinical usefulness.
